Scripts from Hermes Agent's official optional skills (MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Nous
Research), copied unchanged from the image `nousresearch/hermes-agent:v2026.9.24`:
`finance/stocks`, `research/rss-feeds`, `social-media/reddit-reading`,
`research/domain-intel`, `devops/watchers`. `research_tools.py` runs them as narrow
tools, so an agent without a terminal can use them. The MIT licence is in `LICENSE`. Refresh them when Hermes is upgraded.
